column1: # upstream HMMER vs pyhmmer vs this fork (dev/perf/series.py --mask-tail --file vs_pyhmmer.tsv).
# The scenarios of dev/profiling/RESULTS.md and the Pfam-A annotation benchmark (annot.tsv), changed only
# where pyhmmer can't follow: every run writes the two tables (--tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom) and
# sends hmmsearch's main output to /dev/null, which pyhmmer doesn't have (-A is dropped from W1 too).
# The pyhmmer side is dev/perf/pyhmmsearch.py, made a snapshot by dev/perf/pyhmmer.sh; it accepts only
# the options used here. Plan and results: dev/profiling/PYHMMER.md.
#   D/, F/, U/, $NCPU: as in workloads.tsv and annot.tsv
# The sets don't start with cpu or reader, so no run is under perf stat: every scenario is judged by
# wall time (perf stat slows threaded runs on this VM, ab.COUNTER_SETS).
# Threaded runs pin -Z or use --cut_ga, so their outputs are deterministic (workloads.tsv).
@fixture Pfam-A.hmm.h3m  ln -sf D/Pfam-A.hmm Pfam-A.hmm && hmmpress Pfam-A.hmm > /dev/null
# ---- vs: RESULTS.md scenarios at $NCPU threads (the _dbc ones run only where --dbcache exists)
X5_human_pfam1k_cN       vs         --cpu $NCPU --cut_ga -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_1k.hmm D/human.fa
X5_human_pfam1k_cN_dbc   vs         --cpu $NCPU --dbcache --cut_ga -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_1k.hmm D/human.fa
X4_pfamA_h3m_cN          vs         --cpu $NCPU -Z 5 -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom F/Pfam-A.hmm.h3m D/q_pick5.fa
X4_pfamA_h3m_cN_dbc      vs         --cpu $NCPU --dbcache -Z 5 -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom F/Pfam-A.hmm.h3m D/q_pick5.fa
X4_pfamA_txt_cN          vs         --cpu $NCPU -Z 5 -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/Pfam-A.hmm D/q_pick5.fa
X3_p1k_s1k_cN            vs         --cpu $NCPU -Z 999 -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_1k.hmm D/sprot_1k.fa
X3_p1k_s1k_cN_dbc        vs         --cpu $NCPU --dbcache -Z 999 -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_1k.hmm D/sprot_1k.fa
X1_p100_50k_cN           vs         --cpu $NCPU -Z 51857 --noali -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_100.hmm D/sprot_50k.fa
X2_m200_sprot_cN         vs         --cpu $NCPU -Z 570420 --noali -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/kern_M200.hmm D/sprot.fa
# ---- vs1: the single-threaded RESULTS.md scenarios (hmmsearch --cpu 0, pyhmmer in its main thread)
W2_mix_10k               vs1        --cpu 0 -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_len_mix.hmm D/sprot_10k.fa

W5_med_1k_max            vs1        --cpu 0 --max -o /dev/null --tblout t.tbl --domtblout t.dom D/pfam_len_med.hmm D/sprot_1k.fa
